name: Princess Louise
source:
Sister of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Louise was popular among the Koor and a possible candidate to be the next ruler of the Kingdom, until she was caught in a compromising situation by her [url=https://vndb.org/c165850]husband[/url] with another nobleman. The scandal surprised many as their marriage was thought to be solid.
